description_zh: 获取指定条件下的发送数据

parameters.help_en: The sender address. If you do not specify this parameter, statistics for all sender addresses are returned
parameters.help_zh: 发信地址。不填，代表所有地址
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The start time for the query. The date cannot be more than 30 days in the past. The format must be `YYYY-MM-DD`
parameters.help_zh: 起始时间，时间不能早于30日，格式yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time for the query. The time range between `StartTime` and `EndTime` cannot exceed 7 days. The format must be `YYYY-MM-DD`
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，和起始时间跨度不能超出7天，格式yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The email tag. If you do not specify this parameter, statistics for all tags are returned
parameters.help_zh: 邮件标签。不填，代表所有标签
parameters.name: tag_name

parameters.help_en:
If you use Dedicated IPs, specify the ID of the dedicated IP pool to query.

If you do not specify this parameter, statistics for all resources are returned
parameters.help_zh:
对于独立IP用户，查询特定的独立IP池ID的数据

不填写此参数时默认查询所有数据
parameters.name: dedicated_ip_pool_id

parameters.help_en:
If you use Dedicated IPs, use this parameter to filter statistics by a specific Dedicated IP.

If you do not specify this parameter, statistics for all dedicated IPs that match the other criteria are returned
parameters.help_zh:
对于独立IP用户，查询特定的独立IP的数据。

不填写此参数时默认查询所有数据
parameters.name: dedicated_ip

parameters.help_en:
If you use Dedicated IPs, use this parameter to filter statistics by a specific Email Service Provider (ESP). Valid values are:

`gmail.com`

`yahoo.com`

`outlook.com`

`icloud.com`

`others` (matches data for all other ESPs)

If you do not specify this parameter, statistics for all ESPs are returned
parameters.help_zh:
对于独立IP用户，查询特定的ESP数据的数据，可以填写的值如下
gmail.com
yahoo.com
outlook.com
icloud.com
others（对应其他的非上述ESP的数据）

不填写此参数时默认查询所有数据
parameters.name: esp

TotalCount.description_en: The total count of data records
